# region imports
from AlgorithmImports import *
# endregion

class EquityBBBreakdownTurtleAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    _long_threshold = -2.0
    _short_threshold = 2.0

    def initialize(self) -> None:
        self.set_start_date(2024, 9, 1)
        self.set_end_date(2024, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(100000)
        self.settings.seed_initial_prices = True
        self._equity = self.add_equity("SPY", Resolution.DAILY)
        self._bb = self.bb(self._equity.symbol, 20, 2, Resolution.DAILY)
        # Warm up the BB indicators so they're ready to use as soon as the algorithm starts trading.
        for bar in self.history[TradeBar](self._bb, self._equity, self.date_rules.every_day(self._equity.symbol), self.time_rules.after_market_open(self._equity.symbol, 1), 20):
            self._bb.update(bar)
        self.schedule.on(self.date_rules.every_day(self._equity.symbol), self.time_rules.before_market_open(self._equity.symbol, 1), self._check_bb)

    def _check_bb(self) -> None:
        if not self._bb.is_ready:
            return
        price = self._equity.price
        bb = self._bb.current.value
        if not self._equity.invested and price < bb[1]:
            self.set_holdings(self._equity, 1)
        elif self._equity.invested and price > bb[0]:
            self.liquidate()
